arctic research medic, pre-industrial, rendered as graphite concept art concept art moodboard, a cinematic grade, lacquered black perspex

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Lighting reference: golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
